title: Dolce Far Niente Vacation Rental
meta_description: Dolce Far Niente is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to Dolce Far Niente, located at 70 Sunset Ridge Lane, a beautifully furnished WaterColor retreat nestled beneath the towering oaks of the coveted Park District. Meaning "the sweetness of doing nothing," this four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bath home invites you to slow down, reconnect, and embrace the relaxed rhythm of life along 30A. Perfectly positioned just a two-minute bike ride from the WaterColor Beach Club and beach access, and only four minutes from the charming shops, restaurants, and vibrant atmosphere of Seaside, Dolce Far Niente blends timeless coastal elegance with thoughtful amenities to create the perfect setting for unforgettable family vacations. Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 12 Passes Included 6-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Included in Rental 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Prime Park District Location Outdoor Shower Gas Grill Parking for 2 Vehicles 4-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside 2-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor's Beach Club and Beach Access Experience the Home Step inside Dolce Far Niente and discover inviting interiors thoughtfully designed for effortless coastal living. Sunlight pours into the open-concept living spaces, where the spacious living room, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen come together to create the heart of the home. Whether you're preparing breakfast before a morning bike ride, gathering for lunch after the beach, or lingering around the table over dinner, every space encourages connection and relaxation. A first-floor king guest suite with a private en-suite bathroom offers convenient accommodations for grandparents, couples, or anyone who prefers main-level living. Nearby, a laundry room and powder bath add everyday convenience, allowing everyone to settle in and feel at home from the moment they arrive. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat, featuring a king bed, cozy sitting area, private balcony, and a spa-inspired bathroom complete with a soaking tub and walk-in shower. Two additional guest suites, one with a king bed and one with two queen beds, each include private bathrooms, providing every guest with their own comfortable space to unwind after a day spent enjoying WaterColor. Outside, start your mornings with coffee on the porch, rinse away the sand in the outdoor shower after an afternoon at the beach, or gather around the grill for an evening cookout beneath the coastal sky. With the included six-passenger street-legal electric cart and four adult bikes, exploring WaterColor and neighboring Seaside is as relaxing as the vacation itself. True to its name, Dolce Far Niente is more than a vacation home, it's an invitation to slow down, savor the simple moments, and enjoy the company of those who matter most. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Kitchen Living Room Dining Area Laundry Room Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower Second Floor: Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower and Soaking Tub Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds (4), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combination Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower Sitting Area: Full Sleeper Sofa (2) Life in WaterColor Perfectly positioned in WaterColor's desirable Park District, Dolce Far Niente places you just moments from the community's most celebrated amenities. Cruise to the WaterColor Beach Club in the included street-legal electric cart, spend the afternoon lounging beside resort-style pools or on the sugar-white beaches of the Emerald Coast, and explore miles of scenic walking and biking trails beneath WaterColor's iconic oak canopy. Just beyond the community, discover the charm of nearby Seaside with its locally owned boutiques, award-winning restaurants, seasonal events, and vibrant town center. Paddleboard or kayak across Western Lake, enjoy sunset strolls along the Gulf, or simply embrace the slower pace that makes WaterColor one of 30A's most beloved destinations. Whether you're visiting for the first time or continuing a family tradition, WaterColor offers the perfect blend of natural beauty, luxury amenities, and timeless coastal charm—creating the kind of vacation you'll look forward to year after year.
